HEADINGS: exactly one h1 (Form 1040: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return, 1954) is followed by h2 sections and h3 subsections with no skipped level.","4. LANDMARKS: a main landmark with id main-content wraps the content (header and navigation noted above as missing).","5. IMAGES: no img elements are present, so no alt text is missing.","6.
